Shock resistance and 200-metre water resistance give it practical appeal, while the conservation connection adds meaning beyond its anniversary status.

Gucci’s signature GG motif meets The North Face’s outdoor heritage in this women’s padded short jacket. Part of a collaboration that connects luxury fashion with a spirit of exploration, it brings distinctive pattern and practical warmth to everyday outerwear.

Outdoor utility meets Italian fashion in the Gucci x The North Face Padded Vest Green/Black. Its green and black palette gives the padded silhouette a grounded, versatile look, while the collaboration brings Gucci’s expressive style to The North Face’s outdoor heritage. Easy to layer over a hoodie or knit, it adds warmth without covering the arms, making it a distinctive choice for transitional weather.

The Chrome Hearts x Drake Chrome Hand Dyed Hoodie brings a distinctive, hand-dyed finish to a familiar streetwear staple. The collaboration connects Drake’s influence on music and style with Chrome Hearts’ rebellious design identity, rooted in its 1988 beginnings as a leather-focused label. Tonal variations give the hoodie its visual character, making it a natural focal point for an otherwise simple, relaxed outfit.

Introduced in 2022, the Tudor Black Bay Pro 39mm pairs vintage expedition watch character with modern travel practicality. Its fixed steel 24-hour bezel and yellow GMT hand track a second time zone, while the local hour hand adjusts independently when you land. Signature Snowflake hands, 200 metres of water resistance and a manufacture movement with a 70-hour power reserve make it a capable everyday companion.

Gucci’s signature GG motif meets outdoor heritage in the Gucci x The North Face Padded Jacket in Beige/Ebony. The neutral palette gives the bold pattern an earthy feel, while the padded silhouette brings warmth and volume to cold-weather outfits. Part of a collaboration that debuted in 2021, it pairs Gucci’s expressive style with The North Face’s exploration-focused identity, making practical outerwear feel anything but ordinary.

The Tudor Black Bay Ceramic 41mm brings the brand’s diving heritage into contemporary focus. Its matte black ceramic case, dark dial and signature Snowflake hands create a distinctive, understated look. Inside, a METAS-certified Master Chronometer movement offers independently tested precision and resistance to strong magnetic fields. A power reserve of around 70 hours and water resistance to 200 metres add everyday substance to the striking design.

The Tudor Black Bay Ceramic 41mm gives the brand’s dive-watch heritage a strikingly modern edge. Introduced in 2021, it pairs a matte black ceramic case with signature Snowflake hands, a design Tudor first used in 1969. METAS Master Chronometer certification confirms its precision and magnetic resistance, while a 70-hour power reserve and 200-metre water resistance bring everyday practicality to its dark, understated design.

The Supreme x Louis Vuitton Box Logo Hooded Sweatshirt Red brings two unmistakable design signatures together: Supreme’s bold chest logo and Louis Vuitton’s all-over monogram. Released as part of their landmark 2017 collaboration, it captures a pivotal moment when skate culture and luxury fashion shared the runway. The vivid red backdrop makes the white graphics pop, giving a familiar hoodie silhouette lasting visual impact.

The Louis Vuitton Don Kanye Cream pairs a soft cream suede upper with a substantial sole, bringing understated color to a bold low-top silhouette. Part of Kanye West’s 2009 Louis Vuitton collaboration, the Don was named after his longtime associate Don C. Its exaggerated heel detailing and tonal finish capture an early meeting of luxury fashion and hip-hop sneaker culture, giving it significance beyond its distinctive shape.

The Louis Vuitton Nike Air Force 1 Mid by Virgil Abloh White brings a luxury perspective to a basketball classic. White leather, Louis Vuitton detailing and the signature ankle strap give the familiar silhouette a fresh identity. First presented in Louis Vuitton’s Spring-Summer 2022 menswear collection, Abloh’s Air Force 1 collaboration connects sneaker culture with fine craftsmanship, making this pair a distinctive chapter in footwear design.

Featuring 7.50 carats of sapphires alongside diamonds, this ladies’ bracelet pairs rich color with bright sparkle. Sapphires have long been associated with wisdom and royalty, giving the design a sense of tradition beyond its beauty. The contrast between the gemstones adds visual interest, while their natural durability makes them well suited to jewelry worn and enjoyed, whether for a celebration or a dressed-up evening.

The Rolex Oyster Perpetual Lady Datejust 28mm pairs a compact case with the everyday usefulness of an automatic movement and a clearly magnified date display. Continuing a line introduced in 1957, it carries the Datejust’s familiar styling in proportions suited to smaller wrists. Water resistance to 100 metres adds practical reassurance, while a choice of dials, metals and bracelets makes this classic feel personal.

The Rolex Oyster Perpetual 41 pairs a silver dial with a 41mm Oystersteel case for a clean, versatile look. Sunray finishing gives the dial subtle depth, while luminous hands and hour markers keep it legible after dark. Its waterproof Oyster case and self-winding movement build on Rolex innovations dating to 1926 and 1931, combining enduring design with practical benefits, including 100-metre water resistance and approximately 70 hours of power reserve.

The Rolex Oyster Perpetual Pink Dial 34mm pairs a soft pink dial with the clean lines of a stainless steel Oyster case and bracelet. Its compact proportions make it an easy everyday companion, while the uncluttered, date-free display keeps the focus on legibility. Rooted in Rolex’s pioneering waterproof case design of 1926, it combines understated character with automatic winding and 100 metres of water resistance.

The Chanel Classic Double Flap Jumbo in beige brings together quilted caviar leather, gold-tone hardware and the signature interlocking CC clasp. Rooted in Karl Lagerfeld’s reinterpretation of Chanel’s flap bag in the 1980s, its design balances heritage with everyday practicality. The pebbled leather helps disguise light wear, while the generous Jumbo size offers room for daily essentials and the leather-threaded chain adds a distinctive finishing touch.

Louis Vuitton’s Damier pattern meets vivid graffiti graphics on the Nike Air Force 1 Mid by Virgil Abloh, turning a basketball classic into a canvas for luxury and street culture. Introduced through Louis Vuitton’s Spring Summer 2022 collection, the collaboration reflects Abloh’s boundary-blurring approach to design. The familiar mid-cut shape and ankle strap ground the expressive artwork in unmistakable Air Force 1 DNA.

Created for Moncler’s 70th anniversary, the Maya 70 by Palm Angels Jacket in Bright White puts Francesco Ragazzi’s streetwear perspective on an alpine icon.
